recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any broader cleanup of request resource aliases should be handled by a new work-group decision rather than inferred from FHIR-50429.
issue_request: FHIR-50429 asked whether Request pattern/request resources should use .groupIdentifier, .grouperId, or .requisition consistently. It was Applied for R6 with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: keep ServiceRequest.requisition and the workflow mappings, and remove the alternate names.
initial_application: Commit 818e079dea09203ac42b020e3793cd53c4324fec removed the two ServiceRequest.requisition alias lines for grouperId and groupIdentifier from source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml. The combined branch did not previously contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-50429.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes transferred the issue to OO as not persuasive with modification because requisition does not fit several other request resources. OO WGM minutes recorded the narrow outcome: keep the ServiceRequest.requisition name, keep the mapping to .groupIdentifier, and remove the group identifier alternate naming. Source searches still find some aliases on other groupIdentifier resources, but no Jira/community evidence broadened this OO ServiceRequest decision into a cross-resource alias cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml already has ServiceRequest.requisition mapped to Request.groupIdentifier with no grouperId or groupIdentifier aliases.
